runs.title: Build Agent Run Viewer Component
runs.summary: Observability component visualizing Antigravity multi-agent orchestration flows from task dispatch through parallel discovery, join synthesis, scoped worker implementation, and deterministic verification.

steps.name: Task Deconstruction & Dispatch
steps.summary: Evaluated task complexity (Diagnostic), framed orthogonal discovery questions, and dispatched concurrent read-only Scouts.
steps.input:
User goal: Agent Run Viewer for DataWarsaw website.
Constraints: Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS, no heavy libraries, explicit DEMO badge, responsive 375px–1440px.
steps.output: Spawning Scout A (Runtime/Data) and Scout B (UX/Info Design) with bounded context contracts.

agents.name: Runtime & Telemetry Investigation
agents.summary: Audited repository state and runtime artifacts. Determined persistent telemetry is not yet checked in; recommended minimal JSON schema with explicit DEMO label.
agents.input: Inspect state/, agents/, .agents/, docs/, evals/ for truthful runtime data.
agents.output: Proposed minimal extensible JSON schema. Mandated DEMO RUN flag to avoid fabricating historical telemetry.

agents.name: Information Architecture & UX Design
agents.summary: Designed visual hierarchy matching Warsaw Analytica dark graphite/acid-lime aesthetic. Recommended Section 06 placement with responsive horizontal-to-vertical branch flow.
agents.input: Inspect site/ structure, visual tokens, responsive rules, and layout constraints.
agents.output: Proposed execution trace hierarchy: Header → Coordinator → Parallel Branches → JOIN → Worker → Verification → Inspector.

steps.name: Synthesis & Implementation Contract
steps.summary: Joined Scout findings, confirmed zero contradictions, and formulated single consolidated implementation brief for Worker.
steps.input: Scout A schema recommendation + Scout B UX layout specifications.
steps.output: Consolidated implementation brief with file scope: site/data/agent-runs.json, site/index.html, site/styles.css, site/script.js.

steps.name: Component Implementation & Rendering
steps.summary: Constructed Agent Run Viewer component, dynamic run switcher, interactive node inspector, responsive SVG branch connectors, and keyboard controls.
steps.output: Implemented component with zero external visualization frameworks; pure semantic HTML5, CSS Grid/Flexbox, and vanilla JavaScript.

steps.name: QA & Responsive Evaluation
steps.summary: Verified zero horizontal overflow across 375px, 390px, 430px, 768px, 1024px, 1440px; verified zero console errors, keyboard focus, and reduced-motion states.
steps.input: Test suite: test-datawarsaw-web & visual regression checklist.
steps.output: All 4 viewports passed (scrollWidth === innerWidth). Reduced-motion transitions validated. Contrast ratios compliant.

runs.title: Simplify Warsaw Weather Chart
runs.summary: Streamlined 24-hour temperature chart by removing visual clutter while preserving comprehensive Open-Meteo multi-factor recommendation engine.

steps.name: Direct Task Routing
steps.summary: Classified task as Simple Refinement. Affected file (site/script.js, site/styles.css) and goal known; skipped Scout swarm to minimize overhead.
steps.input: User goal: Simplify weather chart to temperature-only visualization while retaining multi-signal decision logic.
steps.output: Direct delegation to Worker with strict scope isolation.

steps.name: Chart Refactoring
steps.summary: Refactored SVG rendering to clean single-axis temperature curve with smooth area fill and dynamic mobile tick density.
steps.output: Cleaned up SVG layout, responsive dynamic ticks (3-4 mobile, 6 desktop).

steps.name: Chart & Data Validation
steps.summary: Tested API fallback, keyboard navigation across timeline hours, and zero layout shift on mobile viewports.
steps.input: Test suite: test-datawarsaw-web & Open-Meteo mock responses.
checks: Mobile tick density: PASS (4 ticks at 375px)

runs.title: Fix Polish Diacritics UTF-8 Encoding
runs.summary: Resolved corrupted UTF-8 string encoding in Warsaw weather outdoor recommendation strings across Polish diacritical characters (ą, ć, ę, ł, ń, ó, ś, ź, ż).

steps.name: Diagnosis Dispatch
steps.summary: Identified garbled characters in dynamic weather output; dispatched Scout to isolate string literals and file encoding.
steps.input: Issue: Polish diacritics rendered as mojibake in recommendation banner.
steps.output: Scout contract: Inspect string declarations in site/script.js and verify BOM/UTF-8 encoding.

steps.name: Encoding Correction & String Normalization
steps.summary: Replaced corrupted character sequences with clean UTF-8 literals and validated file save encoding.
steps.input: Scout findings and string correction list.

steps.name: Character Set & Display QA
steps.summary: Simulated all 12 weather conditions and verified proper glyph rendering in browser DOM.
steps.input: Test script: string regex & DOM rendering checks.
steps.output: Zero mojibake detected across all conditions.
